name: African Elephant

name: African Wild Dog

name: Alligator

name: Alpaca

name: Anaconda

name: Arctic Fox

name: Armadillo

name: Axolotl

name: Baboon

name: Bactrian Camel

name: Badger

name: Bald Eagle

name: Barn Owl

name: Barracuda

name: Beaver

name: Bison

name: Black Bear

name: Bongo

name: Bottlenose Dolphin

name: Box Jellyfish

description: The harbor seal is a compact true seal built around underwater control, repeated diving and extraordinary whisker-based tracking.

name: Secretary Bird
description: The Secretary Bird is a long-legged African ground raptor built around precision impact rather than grappling.

name: Serval
description: The serval is a 14 kg African grassland cat built around acoustic precision and explosive vertical pouncing.

name: Shoebill
description: A towering African marsh predator built around patience rather than pursuit.

name: Siberian Tiger
description: The Amur tiger is a cold-hardy, solitary heavyweight cat built around stealth, explosive acceleration and close-range control.

name: Skunk
description: The striped skunk is a small North American omnivore whose modest physical combat power is transformed by one of the roster's strongest deterrent systems.

name: Sloth
description: The pale-throated three-toed sloth is a small, highly specialized rainforest canopy mammal built for secure suspension, camouflage and extreme energy conservation.

name: Sloth Bear
description: A shaggy South Asian bear specialized for termites but armed for a violent close-range defense.

name: Snapping Turtle
description: The common snapping turtle is a heavily built freshwater ambush predator whose real danger comes from a rapid long-necked beak strike backed by partial shell armor.

name: Snow Leopard
description: A 50 kg adult male snow leopard is a specialized mountain ambush cat built around claws, a throat bite, camouflage and extraordinary terrain control.

name: Snowy Owl
description: The Snowy Owl is a roughly 2.15 kg Arctic raptor whose real strengths are precision, senses and mobility rather than brute force.

name: Spectacled Bear
description: The spectacled bear is a strongly dimorphic Andean ursid whose prime males average around 115 kg.

name: Spider Monkey
description: A long-limbed, thumbless acrobat of Central American rainforests, Geoffroy's spider monkey swings beneath branches and hangs by a tail that works like a fifth hand.

name: Stag Beetle
description: Europe's largest beetle, the stag beetle is famous for the male's antler-like mandibles, used to lift rivals and throw them off branches.

name: Stingray
description: A broad, diamond-shaped western Atlantic ray, the southern stingray hunts buried prey with an electrical sense and protects itself with a serrated, venom-coated tail spine.

name: Stoat
description: A slender, fearless mustelid of the northern world, the stoat kills rabbits and birds many times its size with a bite to the back of the neck, and swims, climbs and squeezes through burrows with ease.

name: Stork
description: A tall black-and-white wader with long red legs and a dagger-like red bill, the white stork stalks meadows for frogs, rodents and insects and soars thousands of kilometres between Europe and Africa…

name: Sugar Glider
description: A 140-gram gliding possum that wins by leaving: the sugar glider can steer a 50-metre glide between trees, sees ultraviolet light at night and can drop into torpor to wait out storms.

name: Sun Bear
description: The smallest bear, but one of the fiercest for its size: the sun bear carries 10 cm sickle claws, a bite of about 2,000 N at the molars and loose skin that lets it twist round and bite anything that…

name: Swan
description: The mute swan is an 11-kilogram waterbird with a big temper. It defends its nest by hissing, raising its wings, then charging with wing blows and bites, and it can drown intruding birds and even…

name: Swordfish
description: The swordfish is a 200-kilogram ocean hunter armed with a long, flat sword that has killed blue sharks and makos.

name: Tapir

battle_profile.primary_environment: Jungles of South America and Asia

description: The lowland tapir is a 230-kilogram forest browser that prefers running to fighting. It crashes through undergrowth, swims and dives well and can breathe through its trunk while hiding underwater.
habitat: Jungles of South America and Asia

name: Tarantula Hawk
description: The tarantula hawk is a 1 g spider wasp whose female hunts tarantulas many times her size, paralyzing them with a precise sting to feed her larva.

name: Tasmanian Devil
description: The Tasmanian devil is a stocky 6–12 kg marsupial scavenger with the strongest bite for its size of any living mammalian carnivore.

name: Tiger Shark
description: The tiger shark is a 4 m, 500 kg generalist predator with serrated, sideways-hooked teeth that saw through sea-turtle shells.

name: Toucan
description: The toco toucan is a 0.6 kg South American fruit-eater with the largest bill for its body of any bird.

name: Tuna
description: The Pacific bluefin tuna is a 2 m, 150 kg warm-bodied fish built for speed and endurance, crossing the North Pacific and turning sharply despite its torpedo shape.

name: Vulture
description: The griffon vulture is a big 8 kg scavenger with a 2.6 m wingspan that soars for hours at almost no energy cost while scanning thousands of square kilometres for carcasses.

name: Wallaby
description: The swamp wallaby is a 17 kg, dark-furred browser of eastern Australian undergrowth that hops with its head low and its tail straight out.

name: Walrus
description: The walrus is a 1.2-tonne Arctic giant armed with ivory tusks up to a metre long, protected by skin up to 10 cm thick and blubber, and equipped with a carpet of super-sensitive whiskers.

name: Warthog
description: The common warthog is an 85 kg African pig with long curved tusks, razor-edged lower tusks and padded facial warts.

name: Wild Boar
description: The wild boar is a 100 kg Eurasian pig with sharp, ever-growing tusks, a rut shield of tough tissue over its shoulders and an excellent nose.

name: Wild Horse
description: Przewalski's horse is a stocky, dun steppe horse and the last truly wild horse.

name: Wildebeest
description: The blue wildebeest is a 250 kg horned antelope built for distance. Bulls clash on their knees with hooked horns and herds mob lone predators, but its real edge is endurance: highly efficient muscle…

name: Wolverine
description: The wolverine is a 16 kg snow-country powerhouse with bone-crushing jaws, crampon claws and snowshoe paws.

name: Wombat
description: The common wombat is a 28 kg burrowing marsupial with ever-growing teeth, powerful digging claws and a cartilage-backed rump it uses to plug its tunnel against predators.

name: Yak
description: The domestic yak is a 450 kg high-altitude ox with sweeping horns, a ground-length coat and a heart and lungs built for thin air.

name: Zebra
description: The plains zebra is a 300 kg striped equid and one of the most combative prey animals on the savanna. Stallions fight with bites, wrestling and kicks, attack hyenas and wild dogs, and families mob…

name: Aardvark
habitat: Savanna, grassland, open woodland, semi-arid scrub
description: The aardvark is a 65 kg African digging specialist that tears open termite mounds with spade-like claws and finds food with one of the most powerful noses among mammals.

name: Aardwolf
habitat: Open grassland, savanna and dry scrub of eastern and southern Africa
description: The aardwolf is a slender, 10 kg member of the hyena family that eats termites instead of meat, licking up hundreds of thousands in a night.

name: African Grey Parrot
habitat: Lowland rainforest, forest edges, clearings and mangroves of central and West Africa
description: The African grey parrot is one of the smartest animals alive, a 400-gram forest parrot that can use words for objects, colours and numbers and track hidden objects better than young children.

weaknesses: Exposed when feeding on the ground

name: Africanized Honey Bee
habitat: Warm open country, farmland and towns across the Americas; nests in cavities
description: The Africanized honey bee is a hybrid of African and European honey bees that has spread from Brazil across the Americas.

weaknesses: Each worker stings a mammal only once

name: Alligator Snapping Turtle
description: The alligator snapping turtle is North America's heaviest freshwater turtle and a patient ambush specialist.

name: American Pit Bull Terrier
description: The American Pit Bull Terrier is a muscular 23 kg bulldog-terrier breed made to grip and hold.

name: Arapaima
description: The arapaima is a giant air-breathing fish of Amazon floodplain lakes, reaching over 2 m and 100 kg. It ambushes fish with a sudden vacuum-like gulp and crushes them on a bony, toothed tongue.

name: Asian Elephant
description: The Asian elephant is a multi-tonne forest giant whose prime bulls combine crushing mass, tusks, a powerful grasping trunk and the testosterone-fuelled aggression of musth.

name: Ball Python
habitat: West and Central African savanna, grassland and open woodland
description: The ball python is a small, stocky constrictor from the savannas and farmland of West and Central Africa.

name: Basking Shark
habitat: Cool temperate coastal and open seas worldwide
description: The basking shark is the second-largest fish alive, a 7.9-metre, 4-tonne filter feeder that cruises open-mouthed through plankton.

name: Bearded Dragon
habitat: Arid woodland, scrub and rocky desert of inland Australia
description: The bearded dragon is a sturdy, spiny lizard from the dry woodlands and deserts of inland Australia.

name: Bearded Vulture
description: The bearded vulture is a 6 kg mountain vulture with a 2.7 m wingspan that lives mostly on bones, dropping them onto rocks to smash them and dissolving the pieces in stomach acid below pH 1.

strengths: Drops prey and bones from height

name: Belgian Malinois
description: The Belgian Malinois is a lean, 30 kg Belgian working shepherd built for explosive speed, leaping and relentless drive.

name: Bengal Tiger
description: The Bengal tiger is the big cat of South Asia's forests, grasslands and mangroves, a roughly 200 kg ambush hunter that kills sambar, wild pig and even adult gaur alone.

name: Betta Fish
habitat: Shallow marshes, floodplains, canals and rice paddies of Thailand and mainland Southeast Asia
description: The betta, or Siamese fighting fish, is a 2-gram paddy fish that breathes air and fights with a ferocity bred into it for centuries.

name: Binturong
habitat: Tropical rainforest canopy of South and Southeast Asia
description: The binturong, or bearcat, is a shaggy 16 kg tree-dweller of Asian rainforests that smells like popcorn and climbs with a grasping tail.

name: Black Caiman
description: The black caiman is the Amazon's largest predator and the biggest member of the alligator family.

name: Black-footed Cat
habitat: Arid grassland, Karoo scrub and dry savanna
description: Africa's smallest wild cat, the black-footed cat weighs under 2 kg yet catches prey on roughly six of every ten attempts and hunts all night long.

name: Black-necked Spitting Cobra
description: The black-necked spitting cobra is an African cobra that defends itself by spraying venom at an attacker's eyes, tracking its target and aiming at the face. Its bite delivers a large dose of…

name: Blue-Ringed Octopus
habitat: Shallow Indo-Pacific reefs, rubble, tide pools
description: The greater blue-ringed octopus is a 50 g reef octopus whose bite carries tetrodotoxin, a nerve toxin with no antidote that can paralyze a human's breathing.

name: Bombardier Beetle
habitat: Dry chalk and limestone grassland, field margins, under stones
description: The bombardier beetle is an 8 mm ground beetle that defends itself with a chemical explosion.

strengths: Aims its spray in many directions
Can escape from a predator's stomach

name: Bonobo
habitat: Congo Basin rainforest south of the Congo River
description: The bonobo is a slim, long-legged great ape of the Congo rainforest, nearly as clever as the chimpanzee but built lighter and armed with smaller canines.

name: Boomslang
habitat: Savanna woodland, karoo scrub and lowland forest
description: The boomslang is a slender, sharp-eyed African tree snake whose small doses of rear-fang venom cause deadly bleeding hours after a bite.

weaknesses: Rear fangs need a held bite

name: Bowhead Whale
habitat: Arctic and subarctic seas with seasonal sea ice
description: The bowhead whale is a 75-tonne Arctic giant that smashes through sea ice with its massive skull, wears the thickest blubber of any whale and can live over 200 years.

name: Brazilian Wandering Spider
habitat: Atlantic Forest floor and understory, plantations, houses
description: A fast, webless night hunter from Brazil's forests, the Brazilian wandering spider backs its dramatic rearing threat display with one of the most medically significant spider venoms.

name: Brown Hyena
habitat: Deserts, semi-desert scrub and dry savanna of southern Africa
description: The brown hyena is a shaggy 43 kg desert scavenger of southern Africa that can smell carrion from 2 km away and walk more than 50 km in a night.

name: Budgerigar
habitat: Arid grassland, mulga scrub and open woodland near water
description: A 30-gram nomad of the Australian outback, the budgerigar survives on flight skill, flock vigilance and water-thrifty physiology rather than any weapon.

name: Canary
habitat: Laurel and pine forest, orchards and gardens of the Canary Islands, Azores and Madeira
description: The Canary is a 20 g finch from the Canary Islands, Azores and Madeira, bred for centuries into the world's best-known songbird pet.

name: Caucasian Shepherd Dog
description: The Caucasian Shepherd Dog is a massive 60 kg mountain guardian from the Caucasus, with a long maned coat and thick skin.

strengths: Heaviest frame of the guardian dogs
Maned coat and thick skin over the neck

name: Chinchilla
habitat: Arid, rocky mountain slopes of northern Chile; homes worldwide as a pet
description: The chinchilla is a 0.6 kg Andean rock-hopper wrapped in the densest fur of any land mammal, which it can shed in clumps to escape a predator's bite.

name: Cockatiel
habitat: Arid and semi-arid open woodland, scrub and grassland near water
description: The cockatiel is the smallest cockatoo, a 90-gram grey nomad of inland Australia that answers every threat by flying.

name: Common Death Adder
habitat: Forest, woodland, heath and grassland leaf litter
description: The common death adder is a short, thick Australian elapid that hides in leaf litter and twitches a grub-like tail tip to lure prey. Its fast strike delivers a potent cobra-like neurotoxin that can…

name: Common Eland
description: The common eland is Africa's giant savanna antelope, a 700 kg bull with thick spiral horns, a heavy dewlap and knees that click as it walks.

name: Corn Snake
habitat: Southeastern US pine flatwoods, forest openings and fields
description: The corn snake is a slender, brightly patterned rat snake from the southeastern United States.

name: Crowned Eagle
habitat: African forests, riverine woodland, wooded gorges
description: The Crowned Eagle is Africa's most powerful forest eagle. The canonical female weighs about 4 kg but has thick legs and massive talons that regularly kill monkeys and small antelope far heavier than…

name: Eastern Brown Snake
habitat: Grassland, woodland and farmland of eastern Australia
description: The eastern brown snake is a fast, slender Australian snake whose venom sets off runaway blood clotting and can cause sudden collapse.

name: Eclectus Parrot
habitat: Lowland rainforest canopy of New Guinea, nearby islands and Cape York
description: The Eclectus Parrot is a stocky rainforest parrot from New Guinea, nearby islands and Cape York, famous because green males and red females look like different species.

strengths: Females fight hard for nest hollows

name: Elephant Seal
description: The southern elephant seal is the largest seal and the largest carnivoran on Earth, with bulls around 3 tonnes.

name: Ethiopian Wolf
habitat: Afroalpine grassland and moorland above 3,000 m
description: The Ethiopian wolf is a rare, coyote-sized red wolf that lives only on the high plateaus of Ethiopia.

name: Eurasian Eagle-Owl
habitat: Woodland edges and open country across Europe and Asia
description: The Eurasian Eagle-Owl is one of the world's largest owls, about 3 kg in the canonical female with a wingspan near 1.8 m. It hunts at night from high perches, taking rats, rabbits and hedgehogs and…

weaknesses: Vulnerable while feeding on the ground

name: False Killer Whale
habitat: Deep tropical and subtropical offshore waters
description: The false killer whale is a 1.3-tonne, thick-toothed oceanic dolphin that hunts tuna and mahi-mahi at speed, shares its catch and has attacked sperm whales and humpbacks in groups.

name: Fancy Rat
habitat: Homes; wild stock in cities, farms and riverbanks
description: The fancy rat is the tame, domestic form of the brown rat: a 0.5 kg climber, swimmer and problem-solver with sharp incisors, keen ears and a strong bite for its size.

strengths: Climbs, swims and squeezes through tunnels

unique_traits: Tame Twin of the City Rat

name: Fighting Bull
habitat: Free-range pasture estates in Iberia, France and Latin America
description: The fighting bull is a half-tonne Iberian cattle breed bred for courage: it charges again and again, hooks with long sharp horns and lifts its target off the ground.

name: Fin Whale
habitat: Deep offshore waters of all oceans
description: The fin whale is a 45-tonne, 20 m rorqual built for speed: the "greyhound of the sea" can sprint to about 40 km/h and hold escape speeds that force killer whales into long chases.

weaknesses: Does not fight back when caught

name: Fisher
description: A long, dark forest mustelid, the fisher is one of the few predators that kills porcupines and has even ambushed Canada lynx in snowstorms.

name: Flying Fox
habitat: Lowland rainforest, coastal forest, mangroves, orchards
description: The large flying fox is a 1 kg Southeast Asian fruit bat with a 1.5 m wingspan that can fly more than 80 km in a night.

name: Fossa
habitat: Madagascar forests, from rainforest to dry forest
description: The fossa is Madagascar's top predator, a sleek, muscular 8 kg carnivore that hunts lemurs on the ground and high in the canopy.

name: Gaur
description: The gaur is the largest wild cattle species on Earth, a tonne-class forest bull armed with thick upcurved horns and wrapped in heavy muscle beneath a towering dorsal ridge.

name: German Shepherd
description: The German Shepherd is a 35 kg German herding and police dog built to trot all day and to finish a sprint with a hard grip.

weaknesses: Prone to hip and spine problems

name: Gharial
habitat: Large rivers of India and Nepal
description: The gharial is a long, slim river crocodilian built entirely around catching fish.

name: Giant Forest Hog
habitat: African tropical and montane forests, forest edges
description: The giant forest hog is the world's largest wild pig, a 210 kg shaggy black boar of African forests that fights by ramming heads hard enough to crack skulls and slashing with flared tusks.

name: Giant Otter
habitat: Slow rivers, oxbow lakes and swamps of South America
description: The longest member of the weasel family, the giant otter is a 30 kg river predator that lives in loud, cooperative family groups and hunts fish, snakes and even small caimans.

name: Giant Panda
description: The giant panda is a 100–115 kg bamboo-eating bear from the mountain forests of central China. Its broad skull gives it a bite modelled close to a lion's, and it can climb well.

name: Goblin Shark
habitat: Deep continental slopes, canyons and seamounts
description: The goblin shark is a pink, soft-bodied deep-sea shark whose jaws shoot forward on elastic ligaments faster and farther than any other shark's.

name: Goldfish
habitat: Weedy ponds, ditches, lakes and slow rivers of East Asia; introduced worldwide
description: The goldfish is a small East Asian carp bred for colour for more than a thousand years.

name: Goliath Tigerfish
habitat: Fast-flowing Congo River channels, Lake Tanganyika
description: The goliath tigerfish is the Congo River's dagger-toothed hunter: a powerful 25 kg fish armed with 32 large, interlocking teeth that it replaces in whole sets within days.

name: Greenland Shark
habitat: Cold, deep North Atlantic and Arctic seas
description: The Greenland shark is a 4-metre, 400 kg Arctic sleeper shark that can live for centuries and cuts round chunks of flesh from seals with a rolling bite.

name: Greyhound
description: The Greyhound is a 32 kg sprint sighthound that reaches about 19.5 m/s within 150 m and holds its speed through tight bends.

name: Guinea Pig
habitat: Homes and farms worldwide; wild stock in rocky, grassy Andean highlands
description: The guinea pig is a 1 kg Andean grazer bred from wild cavies, with nearly all-round vision, a busy social life and a freeze-or-scatter escape plan.

name: Gyrfalcon
habitat: Arctic tundra, coastal cliffs, sea ice
description: The gyrfalcon is the world's largest falcon, a 1.7 kg Arctic hunter that chases ptarmigan and ducks low over the tundra until they tire.

name: House Cat
habitat: Worldwide with people; farms, towns, feral colonies
description: The house cat is a 5 kg pocket predator with the same toolkit as small wild cats: stealth, a lightning pounce, retractable claws and a precise killing bite, backed by superb balance and ultrasonic…

name: Humboldt Squid
habitat: Eastern Pacific open ocean, 200 to 700 m deep by day
description: The Humboldt squid is a 25 kg "red devil" of the eastern Pacific that hunts in shoals of hundreds, striking with elastic tentacles covered in toothed suckers and tearing with one of the hardest…

name: Humpback Whale
habitat: Open oceans and coastal waters worldwide
description: The humpback whale is a 30-tonne, big-winged baleen giant that fights with fluke and flipper strikes rather than teeth.

name: Hyacinth Macaw
habitat: Pantanal wetlands, palm savanna, gallery forest
description: The Hyacinth Macaw is the longest parrot in the world, about 1 m long and 1.3 kg, and it has the strongest measured bite of any bird, about 539 N. That bill cracks palm nuts that are hard to open…

weaknesses: Depends on a few palms and old nest trees

name: Indian Cobra
habitat: Forests, farmland and village edges of South Asia
description: The Indian cobra is the spectacled cobra of South Asia, famous for its hooded threat display and its neurotoxic venom.

name: Indian Rhinoceros
description: The Indian rhinoceros is a two-tonne floodplain giant wrapped in thick, deeply folded hide.

name: Inland Taipan
habitat: Semi-arid cracking-clay plains of inland Australia
description: The inland taipan is a slender 2-metre snake from the remote Australian outback whose venom is the most toxic of any snake in standard lab tests.

strengths: Most toxic snake venom in lab tests

name: Jaguarundi
habitat: Forest edges, dense scrub and farm-forest mosaics near water
description: A long, low, otter-shaped wild cat of the Americas, the jaguarundi hunts birds and rodents by day, climbs, swims and leaps 2 m into the air.

name: Japanese Spider Crab
habitat: Deep seafloor off Japan, 50 to 600 m
description: The Japanese spider crab has the widest leg span of any arthropod, over 3 m in big males, but its long claws are weak and it is slow, gentle and unable to swim.

name: Kangal
description: The Kangal is a heavy-boned Turkish livestock guardian dog bred to stand between sheep and wolves.

weaknesses: Outmatched by bears and big cats

name: Kea
habitat: Alpine zones, subalpine scrub, mountain beech forest
description: The Kea is a large, clever mountain parrot from New Zealand's South Island. The canonical male weighs just under 1 kg.

name: Kodiak Bear
habitat: Coastal forests, salmon streams, alpine meadows
description: The Kodiak bear is a giant island brown bear from Alaska's Kodiak Archipelago, with big males weighing close to half a tonne.

weaknesses: No armor on face and neck

name: Leopard Gecko
habitat: Rocky dry grassland and semi-desert of Afghanistan, Pakistan and northwest India
description: The leopard gecko is a small, spotted ground gecko from the rocky dry grasslands of South and Central Asia. A 50 g adult male hunts insects at night and fights rival males with fast bites, but it is…

name: Leopard Seal
description: The leopard seal is Antarctica's top seal predator, a 420 kg, 3 m hunter with a huge head, long gripping teeth and a snake-like, agile body in the water.

name: Maine Coon
habitat: Homes worldwide; bred from farm cats of the snowy forests of Maine
description: The Maine Coon is the largest non-hybrid domestic cat, a 7.5 kg shaggy "gentle giant" with snowshoe paws, a weatherproof coat and the full house-cat toolkit of claws, bite, reflexes and ultrasonic…

weaknesses: Prone to heart and hip problems

name: Mako Shark
description: The shortfin mako is the ocean's speed shark: a 3-metre, 275 kg warm-muscled hunter that bursts faster than almost any fish ever measured and leaps up to 6 metres out of the water.

name: Markhor
habitat: Steep cliffs and mountain forest of Central and South Asia
description: The markhor is a 100 kg wild goat of the Himalaya and Hindu Kush, famous for males' corkscrew horns that can pass 1.5 m.

weaknesses: Horns suited to wrestling, not stabbing

name: Martial Eagle
description: The Martial Eagle is Africa's largest eagle by wingspan. The canonical female weighs about 4.8 kg and hunts from a high soar, dropping in a long stoop onto hares, monitor lizards, snakes, small…

name: Mexican Red-knee Tarantula
habitat: Dry thorn and deciduous forest and scrub of western Mexico's Pacific slope
description: The Mexican red-knee tarantula is a calm, long-lived burrow ambusher of western Mexico's dry forests, famous as a pet for its orange-banded legs.

name: Mosquito
habitat: Sub-Saharan Africa near people, breeding in sunlit pools and puddles
description: The African malaria mosquito weighs about 2 mg and tracks people by their breath, body heat and appearance before slipping six needle-like stylets into the skin.

strengths: Tracks hosts by breath, heat and sight
weaknesses: No way to injure large animals

name: Nile Crocodile
description: The Nile crocodile is Africa's largest reptile and a shoreline ambush specialist.

name: Northern Goshawk
habitat: Mature forests, forest edges, wooded farmland
description: The Northern Goshawk is a powerful forest hawk. The canonical female weighs about 1.3 kg but kills hares and grouse up to twice her weight.

name: Ocean Sunfish
description: The ocean sunfish is a 400 kg, tail-less giant that swims by flapping two tall fins like wings.

name: Oceanic Whitetip Shark
description: The oceanic whitetip is a bold, 150 kg open-ocean shark with long paddle-like fins and fully serrated upper teeth.

name: Pallas's Cat
habitat: Cold rocky montane steppe and scree
description: A stocky, heavily furred wild cat of Central Asia's cold, rocky steppes, Pallas's cat ambushes pikas and voles from behind rocks and hides rather than runs.

name: Philippine Eagle
habitat: Primary dipterocarp rainforests of the Philippines
description: The Philippine Eagle is a critically endangered forest giant of the Philippines: about 6 kg in the canonical female, roughly a metre long, with a 2 m wingspan and a massive arched bill.

name: Portuguese Man o' War
habitat: Open-ocean surface of warm and temperate seas, often blown ashore
description: The Portuguese man o' war is not a jellyfish but a floating colony of specialised zooids that sails on the wind under a gas-filled float.

name: Pygmy Hippopotamus
habitat: West African swamp forests, forest streams
description: The pygmy hippopotamus is a shy, nocturnal forest hippo from West Africa, about 250 kg of dense body with thick skin and a wide mouth of ever-growing tusks.

name: Rabbit
habitat: Grassland and woodland edges of Iberia; farmland, islands and homes worldwide
description: The rabbit is a 2 kg burrowing grazer built to spot danger early and sprint to cover, with nearly 360° vision, explosive hind legs and a social warren life.

name: Red Deer
description: The red deer is Europe's classic antlered stag, a fast, agile 180 kg forest and mountain deer whose crowned antlers can reach over a metre.

name: Red-eared Slider
habitat: Warm ponds, lakes, swamps and slow rivers of the south-central US
description: The red-eared slider is a small freshwater turtle from the south-central United States, now the world's most traded reptile and a worldwide invader.

name: Rosy-faced Lovebird
habitat: Dry woodland, semi-desert and rocky country near water
description: The Rosy-faced Lovebird is a 55 g parrot from the dry south-west of Africa, a fast, acrobatic flier that can even swing along branches using only its beak.

weaknesses: Must drink several times a day

name: Rottweiler
description: The Rottweiler is a compact, heavily muscled 50 kg German drover and guard dog.

strengths: Strong grip on a broad head

name: Russell's Viper
description: Russell's viper is a stout, chain-patterned South Asian viper about 1.2 m long, with 16.5 mm fangs and a venom that sets off runaway clotting.

name: Russian Tortoise
habitat: Central Asian steppe, semi-desert and foothills
description: The Russian tortoise is a small, flat-shelled digger from the dry steppes of Central Asia.

name: Sand Cat
description: A small, broad-headed desert cat with fur-soled feet and huge ear canals, the sand cat hears prey under the sand, kills venomous vipers and goes without drinking.

name: Saw-scaled Viper
habitat: Sandy and rocky scrub, dry plains
description: The saw-scaled viper is a tiny desert viper, usually under 60 cm and about 150 g, that warns by rubbing its saw-edged scales into a sizzling hiss and strikes from a spring-like coil. Its venom…

name: South American Coati
habitat: Tropical and subtropical forests of South America
description: The South American coati is a 5.5 kg ring-tailed forager of South American forests that climbs down trees head-first and noses out prey with a long, mobile snout.

name: Southern Ground Hornbill
description: The Southern Ground Hornbill is the world's largest hornbill, a 4 kg ground-walking predator that hunts snakes, tortoises, small mammals and insects in family groups across African savanna.

name: Sperm Whale
habitat: Deep open ocean, continental slopes and canyons
description: The largest toothed predator alive, a bull sperm whale combines a 35-tonne body, a battering-ram forehead and the loudest biosonar on Earth.

name: Steller's Sea Eagle
habitat: Cold coasts and river valleys of the Sea of Okhotsk
description: Steller's Sea Eagle is the heaviest eagle in the world: about 9 kg in the canonical female, with a wingspan often over 2 m and an enormous arched yellow bill.

name: Stonefish
habitat: Shallow Indo-Pacific reefs, rubble and sand
description: The reef stonefish is a squat, rock-like Indo-Pacific fish that lies motionless on the seabed and gulps passing prey in a split second.

name: Striped Hyena
habitat: Arid scrub, semi-desert, rocky hills and ravines
description: The striped hyena is a shaggy, 38 kg night scavenger of Africa and Asia whose bone-cracking jaws let it feed where others cannot. It walks long distances, bluffs with a raised mane and can play dead…

name: Sun Conure
habitat: Forest edges, palm groves, savanna woodland of the Guiana Shield
description: The Sun Conure is a 120 g golden parakeet from the edge of the Guiana Shield forests, loud, fast and highly social. Its hooked bill gives a sharp bite for its size and it flies and climbs nimbly,…

name: Sydney Funnel-web Spider
habitat: Moist forest, bushland and gardens around Sydney
description: The Sydney funnel-web is a burrowing Australian spider whose wandering males carry one of the few spider venoms known to kill healthy adult humans.

weaknesses: Venom much weaker on many non-primates

name: Syrian Hamster
habitat: Arid steppe and farmland of northern Syria and southern Turkey; homes worldwide as a pet
description: The Syrian hamster is a 140 g solitary burrower with enormous cheek pouches, ever-growing incisors that can bite through glass and a fierce temper toward its own kind.
unique_traits: Endangered in the Wild, Everywhere as a Pet

name: Takin
habitat: Himalayan and Chinese mountain forests, alpine meadows
description: The takin is a stocky, 320 kg mountain bovid from the Himalayas and western China, with thick swept-back horns, a bulbous nose and an oily, weatherproof coat.

name: Tibetan Mastiff
description: The Tibetan Mastiff is a massive, heavily maned guardian dog from the Tibetan Plateau. It fights with a strong bite, heavy bone and a padded neck, and it carries wolf-shared gene variants that help…

name: Titan Beetle
habitat: Lowland Amazon and Guiana rainforest with old-growth trees
description: The titan beetle of the Amazon is one of the largest beetles on Earth, reaching almost 17 cm. It defends itself with a loud hiss and sharp mandibles said to snap pencils, but adults cannot eat and…

name: Vampire Bat
description: The common vampire bat is a 35 g blood specialist that finds warm skin with a heat-sensing nose, cuts it with razor incisors and keeps it bleeding with anticoagulant saliva.

name: Water Buffalo
description: The wild water buffalo is a heavy, wetland-dwelling Asian bovid armed with the widest-spreading horns of any living bovid.

strengths: At home in mud and water

unique_traits: Wild Stock of a Working Giant

name: Wedge-tailed Eagle
habitat: Australian deserts, arid shrubland, open woodland
description: The Wedge-tailed Eagle is Australia's largest bird of prey. The canonical female weighs about 4.2 kg and spans about 2.2 m.

name: Wels Catfish
habitat: Large rivers, lakes and reservoirs of Europe and western Asia
description: The wels catfish is Europe's giant river ambusher: a 1.6-metre, 22 kg night hunter that finds prey with electroreception and taste-covered skin, then engulfs it with a huge suction gulp.

name: Whale Shark
habitat: Warm open ocean and coastal plankton hotspots
description: The whale shark is the largest fish alive, a 12-metre, 15-tonne filter feeder protected by skin around 10 cm thick and even armored eyes.

name: Wild Turkey

name: Yellow-naped Amazon
habitat: Dry forest, savanna woodland and mangroves of Central America's Pacific slope
